brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 1600×900 (16:9), PNG. This is a brand-new artwork.

Reference guidance: The previously viewed B-culver-black-lime-v3.png is a STYLE reference only: near-black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, ivory typography, hand-drawn ink and rough dry-brush energy. Do NOT copy its player, names, scores, date or pose.
The two previously viewed official portraits are LIKENESS references only: Matt Bonds and Narito Namizato. Never paste, trace photographically, or reproduce any official photograph or logo in the artwork.

Editorial concept: Kanagawa derby, Yokohama BC won both games. Team result shown is from the supplied fixed manuscript only. Game 2 is Yokohama BC 77–66 Kawasaki. These are team points, never an individual statistic. Do not add any other statistics or claims.

Layout: left 48% bold Japanese typography with clear hierarchy; right 52% a dynamic two-player basketball illustration. Let a broad lime brush arc sweep diagonally behind the players and a short rough lime underline support the headline. Restrained composition with generous negative space. Keep all text within safe margins of at least 55 pixels; keep the complete orange ball, faces and hands inside the canvas. No busy arena, crowd, trophies or charts.
Illustrate exactly TWO REAL PLAYERS, with natural anatomically coherent bodies and hands:
1. Narito Namizato (並里成), Yokohama BC: shorter, lean and compact muscular Japanese guard; short softly wavy black hair with visible subtle brown highlights, tapered sides; longish narrow oval face, pronounced cheekbones, straight brows, slim mustache and compact pointed goatee on chin. See his official viewed portrait for likeness. Foreground, head and torso visible in three-quarter view, a low forward-driving dribble stance, one hand poised on a fully visible orange basketball near waist/knee height and the other arm naturally balancing. Plain navy-blue basketball uniform with thin white and red piping, no text, no numerals, no symbols or logos.
2. Matt Bonds (マット・ボンズ), Kawasaki: taller and broad, powerful build; medium-dark skin, very full round black afro, elongated oval face, distinctive fuller lips, short mustache plus full chin/jaw beard. See his official viewed portrait for likeness. Behind and to the far right, three-quarter defensive stance facing Namizato, one open hand raised to contest and other arm naturally out. Plain dark burgundy basketball uniform, no text, no numerals, no symbols or logos. Keep faces bright enough to recognize likeness; strong ivory ink highlights and dark hatching, not black silhouettes.

This is a conceptual basketball matchup illustration featuring randomly selected actual players. It is NOT a recreation of an actual game moment and NOT evidence they played, scored, or were a key performer. Do not portray a winning shot, celebration or a recorded specific play. Do not print either player's name, jersey number, individual points, appearance or achievement. The only ball is the prop used by Namizato.

Style: unmistakably hand-drawn expressive sports ink illustration, confident contours, chunky cross-hatching, limited flat painted colors, tactile dry brush. No photorealism, no photo collage, no glossy 3D. Strong editorial polish. Faces must match their official portrait features, not generic fictional athletes.

Render ONLY these exact Japanese text lines, correctly spelled, with no extra words:
Top small brand text: 「バスケまとめ」
Upper-left eyebrow: 「神奈川ダービー」
Large ivory headline: 「横浜BC」
Largest lime headline: 「2連勝」
Below headline, one clearly legible score line: 「第2戦　横浜BC 77–66 川崎」
Small readable lower note: 「記事記載の結果／個人スタッツ未確認」
Bottom readable disclosure: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Alongside disclosure: 「イメージ」

Make '2連勝' the largest typographic element, and make '横浜BC' sufficiently large and clearly linked to it. The score should be subordinate but legible, with 横浜BC immediately before 77 and 川崎 after 66 so the winner is unambiguous. Footer annotations must be legible and separated from brush texture. No official team logo, league logo, sponsor lettering or watermark. No player names. No other statistics.

ONE PERMITTED REVISION:
Edit this existing thumbnail with ONE precise correction only. The raised defensive hand of Matt Bonds (the afro-haired player in a burgundy uniform in the background right) is clipped by the TOP canvas edge. Lower that raised hand by about 65 pixels and adjust only the adjacent forearm/elbow angle naturally so the WHOLE HAND and all FIVE fingertips are fully inside the image, with at least 35 pixels of clear background above the highest fingertip. Anatomically correct natural fingers, no extra hands or limbs. Do not move the rest of the illustration, alter either face or hairstyle, change the other hands or basketball, or change the text/layout/colors/style. Preserve exactly every existing Japanese text string including 横浜BC, 2連勝, 第2戦 横浜BC 77–66 川崎, 記事記載の結果／個人スタッツ未確認, イラスト（AI生成）, イメージ. Preserve the wide approximately 16:9 canvas and existing resolution. No logos, no new text, no other edits.
